Name: NukaCola
Author: FrostofHeaven
Description:
This mod replaces Joja Cola, the J. Cola Light furniture item, Soda Machine furniture item, and Joja Cola billboard outside Joja Mart with Nuka Cola versions from the Fallout universe! These new completely hand-drawn textures are based on textures from Fallout 4. This mod edits the furniture.xnb, Craftables.xnb, and [season]_town.xnb files.
